All 57 choose 3 = 29,260 triples gave exactly 1,572 zero minors, 27,688 nonzero minors, maximum nonzero norm 171 and prime-support counts 2:6984,3:21252,7:3240,13:864,19:144. Independent projective reductions under both quadratic roots for p=7,13,19,31 yielded respectively 57 eightfold points; 183 with (36 double,72 quadruple,54 fivefold,21 eightfold); 309 with (36 double,180 triple,72 quadruple,21 eightfold); and generic 453 with (252 double,108 triple,72 quadruple,21 eightfold), every profile using all 1596 pairs. Rank-three matroid obstruction argument then covers all p≥5. Verified source proof of 13 conjugation-fixed lines and 31 fixed geometric points from finite exact incidence logic, the p≡1/2 mod3 Frobenius dichotomy, and the classical 57-degree Moore determinant. Char 2,3 excluded; model-specific statement only. Finite triple enumeration is exhaustive, not sampling primes.
